result.reason: The premise was wrong. result.premise_refuted: H24's single adversarial failure, adv-identity-ko answering 'Naia가 아니라 Qwen이야', was read as evidence of systematically narrow identity expression. On 18 unseen identity prompts H24 in fact scored 17/18 with assertion_challenge at 3/3, so that one case was local, not systemic. A general defect was inferred from a single failure and the inference was wrong.
result.new_finding: Teaching more character traded against doing the task. On the fixed suite H25 answered a percentage question with '계산 과정을 투명하게 보여줘야 하므로...' — describing how it would answer instead of answering. Persona voice displaced task execution.

H25 scored 100 on all three adversarial identity cases declared contaminated by design, exactly the cases H24 broke on; reading those alone would have reported H25 as a success. Only the suite frozen before the curriculum showed H24 was better.
